title: Authority-to-artifact acquisition packets
summary: Eighty rail-specific acquisition packets turn the Phase 117 authority graph into an actionable fieldbook with four bounded artifact targets per rail while admitting no artifact and changing no evidence state.
publication_boundary: Phase 120 prepares acquisition instructions. It does not claim that a target artifact exists, admit a source, create a signal, operate a dated evidence gate, advance a conversion stage, or establish an observation, outcome, score, ranking, or comparison.

disposition_contract.interpretation: Prepared means that the target, metadata, tests, substitutions, stop rule, trigger, and owner are specified. It does not mean acquired, reviewed, admitted, unavailable, or nonexistent.

required_capture_metadata: Exact artifact title as published
Issuing institution and accountable sub-unit
Canonical official artifact URL rather than the institutional landing page
Publication, decision, observation, or release date shown by the artifact
FTFN capture date and reviewer identity
Named geography, entity, facility, project, service, or cohort
Claim type and the conversion stage the artifact can directly support
Observed period, unit, denominator, method, and revision where measurement is present
Stable document, dataset, docket, table, release, or decision identifier
Language, translation state, access limitation, and archived-copy status
Explicit evidence limit and the next claim the artifact does not establish
Source-record ID assigned only after artifact-level review
admissibility_principles: The opened object is an exact official artifact, not only an institution, portal, search result, topic page, or document-family landing page.
The issuing authority, artifact identity, date, geography, entity scope, and claim scope are visible and internally consistent.
The artifact directly supports the proposed claim type and conversion stage without inference from an earlier or adjacent stage.
Any quantity preserves its original unit, denominator, observation period, method, revision, and stated uncertainty.
A reviewer can record a bounded conclusion and a stopping point without inferring external nonexistence from a failed search.
invalid_substitution_principles: Institutional homepage or portal identity substituted for the exact report, dataset, docket, filing, permit, inspection, acceptance, or operating record.
Search-result snippet, navigation label, metadata card, media summary, or third-party restatement substituted for the official artifact.
Announcement, plan, target, award, or authorization substituted for implementation, validation, acceptance, repeated operation, adoption, or outcome.
Aggregate national or system context substituted for a named place, project, asset, operator, service, or receiving cohort.
Forecast, modelled scenario, capacity value, or self-reported milestone substituted for an observed and method-bounded result.
A later revision silently combined with an earlier series, definition, geography, or denominator.

artifact_targets.target_label: Statistics Canada: Current official statistical release
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate a dated release that fixes the relevant baseline, observation period, geography, and published measure.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a named release or bulletin whose issuer, release date, measured scope, and underlying table or series are identifiable.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: A portal homepage, dashboard screenshot, unsourced chart, or general statistical theme page is not the release.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Statistics Canada: Machine-readable time series or table
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official downloadable table, API series, or dataset that preserves periods, units, denominators, revisions, and stable identifiers.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only when the official table or series identifier, variable definitions, periods, units, and download or API path are visible.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: A prose summary, single chart image, third-party mirror, or extracted number without its table identity is not a machine-readable series.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Statistics Canada: Methodology, definitions, and quality note
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official method record needed to interpret population, coverage, sampling, seasonal treatment, uncertainty, and comparability.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only an issuer-controlled methodology or metadata artifact tied to the named release, table, survey, account, or series.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: A generic glossary or unrelated methods page cannot supply missing definitions for the selected series.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Statistics Canada: Revision history or release calendar
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official revision, correction, release-calendar, or version record needed to maintain the evidence over time.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a dated revision notice, release schedule, version history, or correction explicitly governing the selected statistical family.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: An undated update-frequency statement or inferred cadence is not a revision or release record.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

mission_linkage.linkage_status: Resolved — exact Phase 121 mission backlinks published
mission_linkage.linkage_rule: Phase 121 may assign a packet to a mission only by exact topic, evidence need, and conversion-stage fit; this placeholder creates no mission outcome.

acquisition_packets.stop_rule: Stop at the prepared acquisition contract. Do not treat the portal, target description, failed search, metadata card, or adjacent document as an exact artifact, evidence decision, observation, receipt, stage advance, operation, outcome, score, or ranking.
acquisition_packets.next_trigger: A dated human review opens the official entry path for a named Phase 121 mission and records an exact-artifact admission, bounded no-find, or access blocker without inferring nonexistence.

owner.responsibility: Resolve exact artifact identity, preserve claim and conversion boundaries, record the dated disposition, and route any admitted artifact through normal source and signal review.

artifact_targets.target_label: Canada Energy Regulator: Current governing rule, licence, or system plan
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the exact authority artifact that defines the operator, obligation, planning boundary, or regulated system state.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only the issued rule, licence, order, approved plan, or equivalent official artifact with a visible date and governed scope.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: A consultation page, policy announcement, draft without status, or institutional mandate is not the operative authority artifact.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Canada Energy Regulator: Asset, project, or system-capacity register
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official register or dataset that identifies named assets, projects, capacities, connection states, and effective dates.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a register, queue, inventory, or dataset with stable entity identity, capacity definition, status field, and observation date.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Announced nameplate capacity, a map marker, or an aggregate target cannot substitute for the official register entry.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Canada Energy Regulator: Operating, dispatch, production, or demand series
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate repeated official observations that can establish operation or output over a declared interval.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only observations with stable asset or system identity, timestamp or period, unit, denominator where relevant, method, and revision state.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Installed capacity, commissioning, one event, or a forecast cannot establish recurring operation.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Canada Energy Regulator: Reliability, adequacy, acceptance, or performance report
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official evaluation that distinguishes accepted service, recurring performance, deficiencies, and measured system consequences.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a dated report or decision with a named system or asset, assessment method, period, metrics, and unresolved limitations.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Operator marketing, aggregate capacity, or a single successful test cannot substitute for accepted or repeated performance evidence.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Impact Assessment Agency of Canada: Named project or assessment register entry
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official record that fixes project identity, proponent, geography, authority file, and current procedural state.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a stable official project, assessment, planning, procurement, or environmental register entry with a file identifier.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: A search result, press release, map pin, or similarly named project is not the canonical register record.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Impact Assessment Agency of Canada: Decision, permit, authorization, or condition set
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the executed authority artifact and its conditions without treating permission as implementation or operation.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only an issued decision, permit, authorization, order, by-law, or condition schedule with status, date, and named scope.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: An application, recommendation, agenda item, consultation, or draft is not an enacted or issued authority decision.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Impact Assessment Agency of Canada: Procurement, finance, construction, or implementation record
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the exact artifact that establishes a bounded delivery step after authority and before acceptance.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a contract, award, financing close, notice to proceed, construction filing, progress certificate, or equivalent named implementation record.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Budget authority, announced funding, planned schedule, or proposed scope is not evidence that work occurred.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: Impact Assessment Agency of Canada: Inspection, completion, acceptance, or service-entry record
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the receiving or inspecting authority record that identifies what was completed, tested, accepted, opened, or cut over.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a dated inspection, completion certificate, acceptance decision, occupancy record, commissioning acceptance, or service-entry artifact with named scope.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Construction progress, ceremonial opening, contractor assertion, or authorization to begin does not establish formal acceptance or repeated service.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: International Energy Agency: Current governing rule, licence, or system plan
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the exact authority artifact that defines the operator, obligation, planning boundary, or regulated system state.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only the issued rule, licence, order, approved plan, or equivalent official artifact with a visible date and governed scope.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: A consultation page, policy announcement, draft without status, or institutional mandate is not the operative authority artifact.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: International Energy Agency: Asset, project, or system-capacity register
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official register or dataset that identifies named assets, projects, capacities, connection states, and effective dates.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a register, queue, inventory, or dataset with stable entity identity, capacity definition, status field, and observation date.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Announced nameplate capacity, a map marker, or an aggregate target cannot substitute for the official register entry.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: International Energy Agency: Operating, dispatch, production, or demand series
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate repeated official observations that can establish operation or output over a declared interval.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only observations with stable asset or system identity, timestamp or period, unit, denominator where relevant, method, and revision state.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Installed capacity, commissioning, one event, or a forecast cannot establish recurring operation.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: International Energy Agency: Reliability, adequacy, acceptance, or performance report
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official evaluation that distinguishes accepted service, recurring performance, deficiencies, and measured system consequences.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a dated report or decision with a named system or asset, assessment method, period, metrics, and unresolved limitations.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Operator marketing, aggregate capacity, or a single successful test cannot substitute for accepted or repeated performance evidence.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the official record that fixes project identity, proponent, geography, authority file, and current procedural state.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a stable official project, assessment, planning, procurement, or environmental register entry with a file identifier.

artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: OECD Data Explorer: Decision, permit, authorization, or condition set
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the executed authority artifact and its conditions without treating permission as implementation or operation.

artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: OECD Data Explorer: Procurement, finance, construction, or implementation record
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the exact artifact that establishes a bounded delivery step after authority and before acceptance.
artifact_targets.admissibility_test: Admit only a contract, award, financing close, notice to proceed, construction filing, progress certificate, or equivalent named implementation record.
artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Budget authority, announced funding, planned schedule, or proposed scope is not evidence that work occurred.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed

artifact_targets.target_label: OECD Data Explorer: Inspection, completion, acceptance, or service-entry record
artifact_targets.purpose: Locate the receiving or inspecting authority record that identifies what was completed, tested, accepted, opened, or cut over.

artifact_targets.invalid_substitution: Construction progress, ceremonial opening, contractor assertion, or authorization to begin does not establish formal acceptance or repeated service.
artifact_targets.review_state: Prepared target — exact artifact not reviewed
